traits.anchorage_per_stem_kg.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES): the median C_reg of its 18 conifer parameter sets (each the mean over four soil groups and three rooting depths), 153 N m per kg of green stem, from tree-pulling tests on about 2,000 conifers (Nicoll et al. 2006 and others). A genus or species with its own tests states its own.

traits.crown_drag_at_rest.note: fgr 2020 (ForestGALES): the medians of its 18 conifer parameter sets for the crown drag coefficient on the silhouette, Cd = C u^-N: C 2.48, N 0.69, fitted between 10 and 25 m/s, after Mayhead's (1973) wind-tunnel drag of whole conifers. A genus or species with its own fit states its own.

traits.reproduction.note: A gymnosperm's seeds lie bare on the scales of a cone or on modified leaves (Biology 2e, 26.2). Most bear seed cones; a few, such as ginkgo and the yews, bear their seeds singly, the rare state here.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson's conspectus (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959): the gymnosperms (cycads, Ginkgo, conifers, Gnetales) are trees and shrubs, with wood; none is a herb.

traits.wood_class.note: Wood Handbook 2021 (FPL-GTR-282), chapter 2: botanically, softwoods are gymnosperms or conifers, seeds not enclosed in an ovary, their wood without vessels; table 5-11a gives softwoods their own functions from specific gravity to green strength and stiffness.
